title: Attention Debiasing for Token Pruning in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying token selection frequency across visual token indices and modeling positional trends in attention scores using exponential fitting to measure the model's disproportionate preference for tokens appearing later in a sequence.

Visualizing retained visual tokens mapped to input images, analyzing hidden-state activations, and comparing pruning behavior across different padding modes (Mean, Constant, Random, Mirror) to evaluate inflated attention assigned to semantically empty padding tokens.
